name: deepseek-harness-relay
description: Delegate and monitor DeepSeek Harness work from any MCP agent.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate and monitor DeepSeek Harness tasks.
interface.longDescription: Delegate scoped work through live Harness models and presets, inspect provider quotas before dispatch, and verify native results. Manage authorized workspaces and idle sessions; use durable wake only when the configured proxy acknowledges it.
defaultPrompt: Discover live models, reasoning, presets and provider quotas before dispatch; select exact provider/model IDs under the user's routing policy. Unknown quota is not zero.
Use $delegate-to-deepseek-harness and native MCP tools with workspace/file references and least privilege. Preserve existing user authorization; never embed source or create a shell RPC client.
Use native workspace registration, idle-session archive/unarchive and new-session preset selection only within the authorized task; metadata does not grant permissions.

Consume and verify terminal results. End a turn awaiting events only when this proxy exposes watch_run and its structured response confirms acknowledged=true and hostMayConcludeTurn=true; otherwise continue native wait_run.

Existing Codex daemon threads support opt-in wake through an operator-configured binding and an independent worker; per-request host metadata selects the binding. Installation alone is not readiness. Verify doctor and every watch acknowledgement; preserve native wait fallback when unavailable.
